recipes.name: Blueberry Almond Oatmeal
instructions: In a saucepan, combine the oats, milk, banana, blueberries, and flaxseeds. Bring to a gentle boil, then reduce to a simmer for 7 minutes, stirring on occasion to prevent burning.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the maple syrup, vanilla, and almond extract.
Divide the oatmeal between the bowls. Top with banana slices, fresh blueberries, yogurt, and almond butter when ready to serve. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based yogurt that is fortified with calcium .
Storage Store the oatmeal, without toppings, in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 2 days.
